From Bohemian Rhapsody · Price: the target must know the story.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 1 action: pull a story character out of a book as a Small minion (1 action to command, lasts 1 minute).
  • 5: Surge: a creature that knows the story becomes its character (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates): it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{fascinated} by its role for 1 round, and you choose one action it uses as that character (control, see Defaults).
  • 9: Two characters.
  • 13: Characters fight with your stand's Strike.
  • 17: Lasts 1 minute.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
